desc:
A high-performance assault mobile suit produced in small numbers at the end of the One Year War, as part of the Principality of Zeon's United Maintenance Plan.
This is the E type (for "einhauen," or "assault"), designed to fight alone against other MS and break through the enemy's defensive lines.
Its basic concept is to perform hit-and-run attacks using the powerful vernier thrusters all over its body, eventually breaking through the enemy's lines and capturing their base.
Thus it is designed for maximum mobility and maneuverability, but its lightweight construction leaves much to be desired in the armor department.
Thanks to its block construction, the machine can be assembled in a simple facility, and so it was assigned mainly to special forces who smuggled it into enemy territory and used it for reconnaissance and sabotage operations.
The name "Kampfer" is German for "fighter."

character.desc:
Deputy leader of the Armored Assault Force's Cyclops Team.
He is a veteran soldier who goes by the nickname "Misha."
He loves alcohol and always has a flask of whiskey around his neck when in the cockpit.
Because of this he is often chided by his team leader Hardie Steiner, but he has talent as an MS pilot.
In a team full of veterans, he is responsible for operating the Kampfer, a high-performance assault MS.
character.name: Mikhail Kaminsky

name: Kampfer (EX)

series.desc:
A half-century has passed since humanity began emigrating into outer space due to overpopulation.
Hundreds of gigantic space colonies now orbit Earth, humans living along the inner walls of the colonies' main cylinders.
With almost half of humankind residing in space, these colonies have become humanity's second home where people are born, raised...and die.
It is January 1, U.C. 0079.
The furthest cluster of colonies from Earth, Side 3, has proclaimed itself the Principality of Zeon and has launched a war of independence against the Earth Federation.
In just one month of fighting, war casualties have halved their respective populations. Humanity is disgusted at the atrocities they themselves have wrought.
Eight months have passed since the rebellion began. They were at a stalemate...
series.name: Mobile Suit Gundam

series.desc:
An OVA planned and produced by Sunrise, released on March 23rd, 1989. 
A small- scale war story taking place during the One Year War featured in the TV show ""Mobile Suit Gundam."" 
It centers on an encounter between Bernard Wiseman, a rookie Zeon soldier, and Alfred Izuruha, a boy living at Side 6's Libot Colony.
In October 1989, Kadokawa Shoten released a novel based on this work.
series.name: Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket
